card.name: Numbers just before acres or area units
card.fires_on: The last piece of a large number, or a quantity word like every or million, right before an area or size unit such as acres or square-foot. It is common in web text describing land or building size.

modes.label: Number before acres
modes.description: A digit or the word million inside a count that is about to be followed by acres.

modes.label: Number before area unit
modes.description: The final zero or digit of a figure before a hyphenated area unit like square-foot or acre.
modes.example: The 54,00<<0>>-square-foot main building of the Wild Center

modes.label: Per-area quantity word
modes.description: A quantity word like every that comes before acre in a rate.
modes.example: removes nearly 100 pounds of P2O5 from<< every>> acre

card.writes: It favors count and quantity words (numberOf, dozen) and disfavors portion and area words.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of a number just before a land or floor area unit like acres comes next.
